children: Overview
Diabetes and obesity drug developer's Q3 net loss narrowed from prior year
Lower R&D expenses drove improvement in quarterly net loss
Company completed Phase II COVALENT-211 trial enrollment; topline data expected Q1 2027
Outlook
Company projects cash runway into Q2 2027
Biomea Fusion expects Phase II COVALENT-211 topline data in Q1 2027
Phase II COVALENT-212 topline data expected in Q2 2027
Result Drivers
LOWER R&D SPENDING - Co said reduced R&D expenses were due to lower costs for nonclinical programs, manufacturing, consultants, clinical activities, headcount, and facilities
COST REDUCTIONS - Decreases in headcount, rent, and professional services contributed to lower operating expenses
